summary.headline: Apomasar’s Judgment on Adversaries
summary.text: Judgment of Aleim son of Isaac recounting Apomasar’s astrological judgments on adversaries, including planetary affliction, opposition, changing winds, and the interpretation of latitudes in questions and nativities. It concludes with a rule that an unafflicted Saturn in a favorable figure gives immutable good, especially to children and descendants.
